translated_title: Murder of Cuernavaca Morena Councilman Gabriel Rivas Was Ordered, Sheinbaum Says
original_title: Ordenaron el asesinato del regidor morenista de Cuernavaca, Gabriel Rivas: Sheinbaum
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez and Alma E. Muñoz
meta_description: Rivas Ríos, a Morena founder, had recently denounced a real estate development in an unsuitable area of Cuernavaca before gunmen on a motorcycle shot him.
